simple.meaning: מַחְבֶּרֶת (machbereth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a junction , i.e. seam or sewed piece.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 26:4. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַחְבֶּרֶת (H4225) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַחְבֶּרֶת (machbereth) / H4225 is traced through Exodus 26:4, Exodus 26:5, Exodus 28:27, Exodus 36:11 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

timeline.evidenceText: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

definitions.full: H4225. machbereth מַחְבֶּ֫רֶת noun feminine thing joined, place of joining ; — absolute ׳מ Exod 26:4 3 t.; מַחְבָּ֑רֶת 36:11 , 17 ; suffix מַחְבַּרְתּוֺ 28:27 ; 39:20 ; — 1 thing joined , of curtain-pieces of tabernacle (compare חֹבֶרֶת ), Exod 26:4-5 , 36:11 (twice in verse); 36:12 . 2 place of joining: a. of the curtains Exod 36:17 . b. of shoulder-pieces of the ephod Exod 28:27 ; 39:20 (all P).
